research_ambition: Seek independently new phenomenon, theory and method, on top of BRFP and accepted OCAR results; this bounded round only tests a joint-maintenance candidate and its inherited explanation.
scope: Public potential DAG, full reachability, frozen independent singleton source, persistent additions, native deletions of base edges consuming the remaining budget. No contract expansion or version/authority changes.
visible_update_input: Old public graph/action set/budget, actual stored additions, fixed candidate IDs, authenticated negative source answers, support proof nodes and dependency index. No hidden true additions, source callback, behavior table or verifier feedback enters update.
joint_target: After every permitted deletion prefix: canonical least retained addition subset, native behavior equal to the complete reference for every remaining failure subset, and a standalone checkable certificate for every omitted non-negative candidate against the actual new representation.
candidate: Represent robust paths as an acyclic proof DAG. A missing formerly persistent support edge can be replaced by its newly established robust path node. Each node uses h+1 abstract paths, sharing only edges outside the remaining deletion set. Do not flatten substitutions into independently chosen literal paths. Transport all nodes after budget consumption; add nodes for newly dropped support edges; validate the entire DAG against current graph and stored edges.
controls: cold_flat: canonicalize the old stored subset, then recompute all omission proofs on the full current graph
dependency_flat: canonicalize identically, transport old flat paths, and recompute only proofs whose concrete supports disappeared
generic_dependency_dag: independently coded bottom-up justification substitution with the same proof language and inputs; a classical compositional-reuse control, not an external TMS implementation
persistent_flat: retain all old additions and transport proofs; behavior/certificates must pass, canonical minimality is not promised and extra storage is charged
common_canonicalization: All canonical methods scan exactly the old retained edges in the same fixed topological-span order, using the same counted bounded-flow primitive. No source reacquisition. New dropped-edge witnesses are available to every method without additional charges beyond the common canonicalization.
development_bank: Use exactly the 60 public DAG role configurations and all 744 source states generated by operator_cold_review_v1.py with seed 20261002. For each source state enumerate every ordered legal deletion prefix of length at most the initial h (h<=2, at most five action edges). No replacement of failures.
fixed_mechanism_cases: The inherited six-vertex dangling-proof counterexample and a fixed family consisting of a base chain, known source-0 shortcuts, longer unknown shortcuts, and a disconnected deletable edge. Use n_chain in [4,6,8,12], h=1, and both all-absent/all-present unknown sources; consume the disconnected edge. This family is deliberately engineered stress evidence, not natural occurrence or independent confirmation.
verifier: Fresh literal BFS under all remaining failure subsets, complete reference additions held only by audit, standalone recursive proof checker with cycle/missing-reference/current-edge checks, and native removal witnesses for every retained addition. Compare all canonical outputs; check every DAG-proven virtual edge natively. Repeat stateful sequential updates, not only isolated one-step resets.
attacks: old dangling literal proof rejected after canonical coarsening
shared deletable edge at a node rejected
stale snapshot and wrong predecessor contract rejected
illegal action or reset budget rejected
metrics: All source calls; initialization flow/augmentations; update flow/augmentations and flow-network edges/BFS arc inspections; proof/index construction and checker node/edge visits; stored addition count; proof node/path-edge counts; separately serialized representation, proof, index and metadata bytes; total serialized bundle bytes and peak across each trajectory. Full producer update including its checker is timed once only diagnostically; no production latency or intrinsic-complexity claim.
working_lemma: Universal-failure robust reachability composes: if each virtual edge in a node has a sound certificate for the same remaining failure family and the proof dependency graph is acyclic, then the node's h+1 abstract paths entail actual reachability under any <=h allowed deletions. Proof by topological induction and the surviving-path pigeonhole argument; ordinary proof substitution/transitivity is inherited, not novelty clearance.
cost_boundary: After common canonicalization, substitution performs no additional flow but stores/checks dependency proofs. Generic dependency-DAG reuse is allowed to match the candidate. Fewer flow calls do not establish lower full cost or superiority over all dynamic algorithms.
freeze: Protocol and constructor/comparators written before running this new bank. Hashes and all denominators retained. Any correction logged; no result-driven variant selection. No sealed 512-unit reads, natural-evidence promotion or paid model calls. Stop after declared checks and report limitations.
